epics.title: Compute Square Roots for Advanced Calculations
epics.description: As a user, I want to calculate the square root of a number to perform advanced mathematical operations conveniently on my smartphone, so that I can easily solve complex problems with a seamless user experience.

user_stories.title: Compute Square Root of Positive Numbers
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to calculate the square root of positive numbers so that I can perform advanced mathematical operations conveniently.
acceptance_criteria: The application calculates the square root of positive numbers correctly.
The application displays the result of the square root calculation clearly.
The application handles invalid input (e.g., negative numbers) gracefully.

user_stories.title: Compute Square Root of Negative Numbers
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to calculate the square root of negative numbers so that I can perform advanced mathematical operations conveniently.
acceptance_criteria: The application calculates the square root of negative numbers correctly, returning a complex result.
The application displays the result of the square root calculation clearly, indicating it is a complex number.
The application handles invalid input (e.g., non-numeric characters) gracefully.

user_stories.title: Handle Edge Cases for Square Root Calculation
user_stories.story: As a user, I want the application to handle edge cases for square root calculation so that I can trust the results.
acceptance_criteria: The application correctly calculates the square root of zero.
The application correctly calculates the square root of very large numbers.
The application correctly calculates the square root of very small numbers.

user_stories.title: Display Square Root Calculation Result Clearly
user_stories.story: As a user, I want the application to display the square root calculation result clearly so that I can easily understand the result.
acceptance_criteria: The application displays the result of the square root calculation in a clear and readable format.
The application uses appropriate notation for complex results (e.g., a + bi).
The application provides an option to switch between exact and approximate results.
